systems.country_label: mfumo wa eRITA: birth certificates issued within 48 working hours, applied for online; launched by the Minister on 12 December 2025 in Dar es Salaam
systems.owner: Registration, Insolvency and Trusteeship Agency (RITA), under the Ministry of Constitutional and Legal Affairs

note: Describes eRITA only as the means of issuing a birth certificate within 48 working hours on an online application; it does not say where or how the birth is registered. Counts given (11.5 million birth certificates, over 1 million marriage and over 12,000 death certificates to 25 November 2025; 20 million registered) are of events, not offices.
